about_the_game:
A roguelike cooking card game blending elements of food and magic into fantastical adventure!

The aging King Pelican has his sights set on the sky paradise of the empyrean, but his beak is too full to reach it. Seeing that he's weighed down by a life of greed, he decides to dissolve his kingdom and return its wealth to the people, one delicious meal at a time.

Feed the People!

Each round you're dealt a random guest and a random meal. Each guest has their own fussiness and quirks about how they want their meal prepared. Manipulate the cards in your hand and deck to find all the right ingredients to cook the meal, but make sure it satisfies the guest's needs too! Are they a glutton, an aristocrat, a fussy child? Each meal is more than just its ingredients, and a good leader knows how to pay close attention to the needs of an individual.

Overshoot the Target!

Complete a set of meals (a feast) by reaching the target score. Reach the target score by preparing good meals. The twist is that all points you get beyond the target score are converted to money, so be strategic about how and when to overshoot the target for big money!

The Magic of Artefacts

But it's not about greed. Use that money to buy magic artefacts that can warp and flip the rules of cooking on their head, to bend reality and create out-of-this-world deliciousness. But beware the looming Devourer - a malevolent bird that feeds on magic and will eat the artefacts right out of your hand.
